result.reason: The redline adds targeted performance, conformity, legal-compliance, malicious-code, and remedy language, but it omits every required warranty duration. It also limits several warranties and remedies to the Interface or to Hosting and Support Services rather than all relevant services, deliverables, and software. The remedy provision applies only to the Interface conformity warranty and contains a scope mismatch by referring to fees for non-conforming services. The changes are otherwise targeted and do not disturb unrelated commercial terms or conflict with the express-warranty carveout in the disclaimer.
